description: Approved scope, policy, objectives, management-review decisions, risk acceptance and exception decisions
authoritative_source: Controlled governance records/GitHub repository or future approved evidence store
hold_rule: Suspend disposition when legal/contract hold or active dispute/investigation applies
disposition_rule: Retire from current use when superseded; preserve decision lineage until approved disposition rule exists
integrity_requirement: Preserve approver, date, version, rationale and supersession lineage
review_trigger: Policy/scope/authority change; legal/contract review; management review

description: CI runs, deterministic tests, isolated integration evidence, benchmark artifacts and verification records
authoritative_source: GitHub Actions/repository provenance and approved test artifact stores
hold_rule: Preserve when tied to active incident, finding, release dispute or certification-readiness evidence
disposition_rule: Dispose only under approved evidence policy after replacement/current-state traceability and holds are resolved
integrity_requirement: Immutable run/result identity where available; failed evidence must not be silently removed
review_trigger: Control change; major release; audit; incident; storage/cost review

description: Incident records, containment, root cause, corrective action, effectiveness and closure evidence
authoritative_source: Approved incident/corrective-action record and referenced source evidence
hold_rule: Mandatory hold while incident, investigation, claim, audit or corrective action is open
disposition_rule: Disposition requires human owner confirmation that holds and applicable duties are resolved; preserve non-sensitive closure history
integrity_requirement: Original observations and corrections remain traceable; no silent rewriting
review_trigger: Incident closure; legal/contract review; recurrence; audit

description: Risk/impact assessments, treatment decisions, residual risk, acceptance and review history
authoritative_source: AIMS risk register and linked authoritative evidence
hold_rule: Hold while risk is open, accepted for a bounded period, linked to incident/finding, or under review
disposition_rule: Retire closed risk from active view only after closure basis/evidence remains reconstructable
integrity_requirement: Preserve prior ratings/treatments, actor, date and evidence state
review_trigger: Risk change; system/supplier change; incident; management review

description: Supplier assessments, terms snapshots/references, security/privacy evidence, incidents, fallback/exit decisions
authoritative_source: Supplier governance register plus referenced supplier/contract sources
hold_rule: Hold during supplier incident, dispute, exit, migration or unresolved assurance finding
disposition_rule: After exit, remove unnecessary sensitive/vendor-confidential material only under approved rule while retaining decision/provenance summary
integrity_requirement: Record source, retrieval/review date, scope, expiry where applicable and uncertainty
review_trigger: Supplier reassessment; terms/subprocessor/model/region change; incident; exit

description: Capability grants, authorization decisions, execution identities, reservations, settlements, work leases and terminal outcomes
hold_rule: Hold while incident, audit, financial reconciliation or disputed action remains open
disposition_rule: Disposition only after authoritative retention rule exists and dependent audit/financial/security obligations are resolved
integrity_requirement: Append-only or tamper-evident where material; preserve revocation/expiry/terminal state
review_trigger: Production activation; authority-model change; incident; financial reconciliation

description: Data source, classification, ingestion, memory/embedding/knowledge lineage and correction/deletion evidence
authoritative_source: Authoritative data/memory systems plus minimal governance references
hold_rule: Hold only when law/contract/incident/investigation requires; otherwise data minimization remains controlling
disposition_rule: Delete or de-identify underlying data when approved purpose/retention ends; retain minimal non-sensitive proof of disposition when justified
integrity_requirement: Do not duplicate raw sensitive payloads into governance records; preserve lineage and disposition evidence
review_trigger: First ingestion; data-class/purpose change; deletion request/process; jurisdiction/customer change

description: Role assignment, competence evidence, training/awareness, exercises and independence/conflict checks
authoritative_source: Approved competence/training records and role register references
hold_rule: Hold when competence/independence is under investigation or tied to an open finding
disposition_rule: Remove unnecessary personal detail under approved privacy rule while preserving role/decision competence evidence
integrity_requirement: Minimize personal data; preserve evidence basis, reviewer and review date
review_trigger: Role/authority change; audit; incident; competence review

description: Public/customer/auditor statements about deployment, security, compliance, certification, autonomy or model behavior
authoritative_source: Approved claim record plus evidence references
hold_rule: Hold when claim is challenged, under audit, part of contract/sales evidence or linked to incident
disposition_rule: Withdraw/supersede inaccurate claim promptly; retain correction and prior-version lineage
integrity_requirement: Evidence state and approval must be traceable; unsupported claims are not deleted to conceal history
review_trigger: New/changed claim; evidence expiry; incident; legal/contract/customer review
